headline: 18 killed, 37 injured in stampede at Kolkata puja pandal
summary: The tragedy occurred at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin puja pandal in Maniktala as crowds rushed for shelter during rain.
details: At least 18 people, including 13 women and 3 children, were killed in a stampede at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin puja pandal in the Maniktala area of Kolkata.
The incident happened on Saturday evening when visitors rushed to find safe shelter from light rain, leading to a chaotic crowd surge.
At least 37 people were injured in the disaster. They were initially taken to Kolkata Medical College Hospital, with 11 critical patients later shifted to PG Hospital.
Witnesses reported that police and fire service assistance was not immediately available at the scene, and no puja committee officials were present during the initial chaos.
West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee visited the hospital at night to check on the injured and expressed deep grief over the loss of lives.
The Chief Minister stated that those responsible for the tragedy will not be spared and has ordered the fire service to submit a full investigation report quickly.

topic: satkhira mob killing prime accused arrested
headline_marked: Satkhira mob killing: [[Prime accused Amini arrested]]
headline: Satkhira mob killing: Prime accused Amini arrested
summary: Fazlul Haque Amini, a local leader of the 'Tawhidi Janata', was apprehended by police and SRB in a joint drive.
details: Fazlul Haque Amini, the prime accused in the murder case of Wahiduzzaman Shamim, has been arrested. He was apprehended during a joint drive by police and the SRB (formerly RAB) at a relative's house in Kaliganj upazila.

Wahiduzzaman Shamim was beaten to death by a mob on October 13. The victim was targeted after an audio recording of a family dispute between him and his wife circulated locally, leading to allegations of blasphemy.
Shamim was attacked in two separate incidents. The first attack occurred in the Kulia area, and the second took place inside the Debhata Upazila Health Complex, where police had taken him for safety.
According to the family, Amini had gone live on Facebook to allege blasphemy and call people to gather against Shamim.
Shamim was later transferred to Satkhira Medical College Hospital, where he was declared dead on arrival. A case was filed naming 10 people, including Amini, and 200 to 250 unidentified suspects.
Police have already arrested two other accused, Mukter Hossain Khan and Asadul Islam Molla, who have been sent to jail.
caption:
A man was beaten to death by a mob after an audio clip of a family dispute was mistaken for blasphemy. Now, the prime accused has been arrested.

Fazlul Haque Amini, the prime accused in the murder case of Wahiduzzaman Shamim, has been arrested. He was apprehended during a joint drive by police and the SRB (formerly RAB) at a relative's house in Kaliganj upazila.

Wahiduzzaman Shamim was beaten to death by a mob on October 13. The victim was targeted after an audio recording of a family dispute between him and his wife circulated locally, leading to allegations of blasphemy.

Shamim was attacked in two separate incidents. The first attack occurred in the Kulia area, and the second took place inside the Debhata Upazila Health Complex, where police had taken him for safety.

According to the family, Amini had gone live on Facebook to allege blasphemy and call people to gather against Shamim.

Shamim was later transferred to Satkhira Medical College Hospital, where he was declared dead on arrival. A case was filed naming 10 people, including Amini, and 200 to 250 unidentified suspects.

Police have already arrested two other accused, Mukter Hossain Khan and Asadul Islam Molla, who have been sent to jail.
